antq_issue_emesan_caravan_city_measures = {
	estate = burghers_estate
	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.01
	}
	allow = {
		parliament_type = parliament_type:antq_emesan_dynastic_council
	}
	chance = { add = 1 }
	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = antq_issue_emesan_caravan_city_measures_outcome years = 10 mode = add_and_extend }
	}
	on_debate_failed = { parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes }
}
